profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Focused on learning new technologies and passionate about making innovative products. Truly believe in automation of tasks and processes in order to allow human brain to pursue other more creative and life changing solutions to problems. Working in such environment brings me joy and makes work feel less like work and more like a hobby.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop high-performance instrumentation graphics using C++ and Qt Creator, rendering incoming and performing outgoing signals like speeds, brake pressure, power meters. etc.

Improved Wi-Fi enabled locomotive monitoring capabilities to allow secure wireless transmission of real-time diagnostics and telemetry data on a web portal.

Serve as Build Manager, taking ownership of the end-to-end compilation, version management, and secure software release delivery to enterprise clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Build Manager · System Administration · GUI development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed features for agents to interact with policies in a full stack application making it easier to access, visualize, and manage policy information
- Designed and implemented a scalable application running as a Docker container on Azure which utilizes MVC architecture, .NET C#, GraphQL, Blazor, Bootstrap, and Telerik components 
- Created a GraphQL API to query the database which reduces over-fetching/under-fetching of data resulting in more optimized data retrieval
- Designed and developed an intuitive user interface (UI) to visualize policies geographically on a map, leveraging the Google maps API
- Migrated the authentication and authorization from a legacy system to Azure App Service ​
- Developed JMeter scripts for performance testing of the API
- Implemented Dynatrace for advanced application monitoring and observability
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · ASP.NET Core · Software Development · Software Industry · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · JMeter · Docker Products · Web Development · Performance Testing

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed and managed .NET C# application which engineers use to interact with dashboards providing real-time insights and visualizations for key performance indicators. Over 3000 engineers use these tools to Collect, Visualize, and Program ECUs in vehicles
- Implemented user-driven enhancements by actively gauging user expectations for new features
- Developed and maintained over 100s of xUnit test scripts 
- Leveraged SQL to extract and visualize data from Oracle database to create insightful dashboards
- Utilized DataDog tool to identify and address performance bottlenecks in the system
- Managed 4 other applications in the maintenance stage and provided expert support for identifying and resolving issues with minor software updates
- Served as a Release Engineer for over 200 tools responsible for end-to-end release cycles, including planning, scheduling, version control, and deployment

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Developed and tested a new transmission software for a CVT program
- Analyzed data collected in vehicle for each new software change in transmission
- Developed and maintained over 100 unit tests for automated testing suite for regression testing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a Regression Testing application using .NET, C#, and XAML, resulting in a 30% reduction in test time
- Automated the release process by implementing a continuous integration pipeline in TeamCity
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · C# · MATLAB · DevOps · Test-Driven Development · Regression Testing

positions.title: Research And Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a Design of Experiment(D.O.E.) to determine optimal temperature to operate transmission in order to help G.M. meet the government requirements for fuel economy by 2025.
• Increased Fuel Economy by 5%.
positions.insights: Skills: Verification and Validation (V&V) · Design of Experiments (DOE) · MATLAB · C++ · Git · Shell Scripting

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: • Researched and developed an algorithm in MATLAB based on Neural Network concepts to self-learn pattern recognition within 60,000 images of handwritten digits.

projects.title: Persona iOS Mobile App
projects.description: Designed, developed, and deployed an iOS app which allows people to review peers on their personality traits to influence positive criticism in work environment.

projects.title: Struggle Buddy - Web App
projects.description: Designed, developed, and deployed an Web app on Firebase, which allows people to anonymously chat with a peer who has faced or is facing a similar challenge to eliminate loneliness and depression.

organizations.name: Performance Driving Team - GM
organizations.description: •	Learning the automotive system as a whole by caring for the hardware, handling high-G maneuvers, optimizing the track time  by imagining the driving line, taking in advice from mentors, and supporting the team as a whole.

organizations.name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
organizations.position: Treasurer of IEEE - University of Michigan · Aug 2016 - Present
